title: New user? Start here · the AI Foundry ET-SoC-1 lab
description: How a new user of the AI Foundry ET-SoC-1 lab starts: first a Tailscale invite from Roman, the lab lead, asked for by direct message on the AI Foundry Discord (never in #community-lab); then three steps from their own computer: log in as root once to create their own account, log in as that account and start Claude on the lab machine in tmux, and give that Claude one line, which has it read the lab's brief, pick a free card, run a first test and keep to the lab's rules.
